about.title: Full Stack Developer
bio: I validate ideas, design MVPs, and build full-stack apps — from concept to production.
Four years in hospitality before code taught me to obsess over user experience and ship for real people.
Currently shipping a farm-management app for Argentina's agro industry — alongside a senior dev, with a local farmer driving real-world testing.

json.name: Leandro Trabucco
json.status: Open to junior full-stack / frontend roles

items.summary: Three-year degree pursued alongside freelance and personal projects. Covers software architecture, data structures, databases, object-oriented programming, algorithms, and modern web development. Adds academic grounding to the work I've been shipping in production, and opens the door to more rigorous backend and systems territory.

Intensive 9-week full-stack program in Tokyo, covering Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, relational databases, REST APIs, and LLM integration. Pair programming, code reviews, and project-based learning from day one. The final two weeks were a team-built capstone ([Nihongo Hero](#projects)) where I led the four-person dev team and shipped a deployed mobile-first PWA.

items.title: Jidou Navi
items.description: Crowdsourced mobile app for discovering Japan's unique vending machines, with an interactive map and gamified check-ins. Built by a two-developer team, covering frontend, backend, and mobile deployment. Now live on the Google Play Store.

items.title: El Alto
items.description: Modern cabin rental website with a smart contact form and chatbot for a 30-year-old family business in Argentina. The contact form and chatbot pre-fill WhatsApp with dates and guest count — built to cut down an 80% incomplete-inquiry rate and streamline direct bookings.

items.title: Calibr.ar
items.description: Workshop management SaaS for Argentine auto shops — repair orders, quotes, inventory, vehicles and scheduling in one place, with custom roles and a full audit trail. Currently in private testing with a real workshop, shaping the product around their day-to-day feedback ahead of a wider launch.

items.title: Nihongo Hero
items.description: A gamified Japanese language learning app with RPG-style turn-based combat. Led 4-person team development in 2 weeks, designing database architecture, integrating VoiceVox TTS API, and serving as top contributor. Deployed as mobile-first PWA.
